notes: Saving is now explicit: press Ctrl+S. The app no longer saves your takeoff in the background - the topbar tells you when something is unsaved.

features: Saving is explicit: Ctrl+S, or click the save indicator
The topbar shows Saved / Unsaved changes / Not saved to a file, and only says Saved when your work is really on disk
Version history: every save keeps the state it replaced - File > Version history to reopen any of the last 20
Crash recovery: unsaved work is offered back next time you start the app
You are asked before anything discards work - new takeoff, loading another PDF, closing a tab or the app
Saving over a different takeoff, or one that changed since you opened it, stops and asks instead of overwriting
fixes: Saving a renamed or copied takeoff wrote a duplicate and left the file you opened untouched
A takeoff whose embedded PDF was corrupt could not be opened at all, even though its counts were intact
Saves could fail while antivirus or OneDrive briefly held the file
